name: Yuri Yokai: Takiyasha Hime
source:
Play as Takiyasha hime, the demon yokai sorceress! Help her retrieve her special tool to conquer humans, or will she choose her high school girlfriend? 

[From [url=https://darumanaut.itch.io/yuri-yokai-takiyasha-hime]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演妖怪女术士泷夜叉姬！帮助她找回征服人类所需的特殊道具，还是让她选择自己的高中女友？

[摘自[url=https://darumanaut.itch.io/yuri-yokai-takiyasha-hime]Itch.io[/url]]
